recipe.visualDefinition: A central square composition featuring a desaturated figure crouching atop a skull filled with flowers, framed by a high-contrast, vibrant floral wreath and a weathered film-strip border.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the small central figure and the large skull base
Color contrast between the desaturated center and the saturated outer floral wreath
Texture contrast between the smooth white background and the gritty, scratched film overlay
Symbolic juxtaposition of life (flowers) and death (skull)
coreInvariants: Centralized square frame within a square canvas
Vibrant red and white floral border
Film-stock technical markings on the inner frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is centered, occupying the middle third of the frame, scaled down to appear miniature atop the skull.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The skull serves as the heavy visual anchor at the center-bottom of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the vibrant outer flowers, move inward to the central figure, then down to the skull and scattered petals.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample off-white negative space within the inner square focuses attention on the central collage.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and light gray provide the neutral background for the central stage.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep reds and dark greens in the outer wreath provide high-value contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white floral highlights and small metallic accents on the figure's clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the periphery fading to near-monochrome in the center to create a 'spotlight' effect.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of modern sans-serif and decorative blackletter-inspired forms.
letterConstructionRules: Vertical orientation for primary text blocks
High contrast between thick and thin strokes in the decorative display type
Uniform stroke weight in the technical sans-serif metadata
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Modernist technical sans-serif paired with aggressive, stylized blackletter for a 'street-gothic' aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, gothic tone of the central imagery.
Provides the necessary 'technical' look for the film border markings.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square digital collage. The outer border is a dense wreath of red and white flowers with green leaves on a black background. Inside this is a smaller square frame with a weathered film border. The center of the inner square is off-white with a desaturated figure in a jacket crouching on a human skull. The skull is overflowing with various flowers and a small bird is perched on it. Add dust and scratch textures across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a semi-transparent gray vertical rectangle on the right side of the inner frame. Place stylized blackletter text vertically within this box. Add small, technical sans-serif text along the left film border and a small dagger icon centered above the crouching figure.

verificationChecks: Is the central figure desaturated compared to the outer flowers?
Is the text oriented vertically on the right side?
Does the film border include technical numbering?
Is the skull filled with floral elements?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the film grain and scratches
Specific pose of the crouching figure
Opacity of the text background box
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Exact film brand names in the border
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the central square is perfectly centered.
Check that the film scratches look organic and not repetitive.
Verify the vertical text is legible despite the rotation.
Confirm the color palette remains grounded in reds, whites, and grays.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central desaturated collage + Vibrant floral frame + Weathered film border + Vertical technical typography.
